extraction.Name: James Williams
extraction.Recorded patent: Filed for record; where and by whom not stated
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged it and lost it as I could not raise the money to pay out
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged for $1800.00 and lost it; A. D. Harris, of Ponca City, Okla. alleged to have defrauded the allottee
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Yes, for debts. Mortgaged it and lost it as I could not raise the money to pay out. Foreclosed, redemption date has not expired.
extraction.NOTES: Mental & physical condition are good. Financial condition bad. Wife and seven children dependent upon him. Allottee states he feels he was defrauded out of this place by one A. D. Harris, of Ponca City, Okla. His financial condition is good [referring to Harris]. Patent delivered at his home. Document notarized December 10, 1928, in Kay County, Oklahoma. Commission expires noted but partially illegible.
